Amin Tavassolian <amin.tavassolian@avicennaresearch.com>:
Dear Genevieve, I hope you are doing well. I wanted to follow up on my previous email regarding our collaboration on the REST-PSLL project, and the value Avicenna can bring to your team. We already have worked with more than 3,000 researchers from more than 100 universities, and we consistently see using an app for participants as part of the research leads to higher participant retention, more engagement, and higher data quality. That's why I genuinely believe our tool could greatly contribute to your upcoming research as well. You can learn more about our work in this Google Sheets file. Please let me know if you are available for a brief chat or demo, and what time might work for you in the following days. Also if you don't want to hear from me, just reply and let me know. Warm regards, Amin P.S: I include my initial email just in case you've missed it: Dear Dr. Melton-Meaux, My name is Amin from Avicenna Research, a Canadian health-research software company. I recently learned about your research project focused on improving at-home recovery for emergency laparotomy patients through innovative technology solutions to reduce complications and enhance patient outcomes, which has secured an AHRQ grant. Congratulations! That certainly speaks to the merits of the project. I am reaching out to explore any potential collaboration opportunities, as I genuinely believe we can help you with this study. We enable researchers to quickly set up participant-facing apps and websites for health studies. Specifically, Avicenna can support this project in the following ways: Simplifying consent and assessing eligibility criteria through the app Presenting participants with surveys and experience sampling to monitor their recovery process Collecting sensor data from smartphones or wearables to track health metrics relevant to postoperative recovery Providing tailored interventions, educational content, and real-time feedback to participants based on their recovery progress Facilitating communication between patients, caregivers, and healthcare teams via televisits or in-app messaging Using the app to increase participant motivation and retention through reminders, goal tracking, and personalized support Here you can find our slide deck with more details on our software. We have worked with thousands of researchers on various topics, and directly mentioned in more than 300 publications, including projects very similar to yours (check our publication track record here). That's why I'm confident we can bring value to your research as well. Would you be open to scheduling a brief call or a demo to discuss this further? You can check my calendar here and pick a time that works best for you. Thank you for your valuable time, and looking forward to hearing your reply. Best, Amin -------- Amin Tavassolian ( My Calendar) Solutions Architect Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data) 4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: amin.tavassolian@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com------

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi all,I hope you are doing well.This is Sara from Avicenna. It's been a while since we last connected, and I wanted to reach out to explore any potential opportunities for collaboration. I was also wondering if you'd be interested in organizing a workshop where we can demo our research platform to your team and work together on implementing a sample project. Our calendar is shared here, just in case. Please let me know how we can best support your work or help streamline your processes.Looking forward to reconnecting.Best,SaraP.S. For your reference, here are some examples of research institutions we've worked with: Interact's Wellbeing project with more than 7,000 participants in Canada. COHESION study with more than 3,500 participants and conducted by multiple universities in Canada to measure the effects and risks of COVID-19 on people's lives. Basic income research with about 4,000 participants in the US, conducted by OpenReserchLab, University of Michigan, Harvard University, and many others. (Every Dollar Counts app) Africa Health Research Institute (AHRI) research with more than 500 participants to understand the role of human movement in the spread of COVID-19 and HIV via Avicenna's custom solution, Sesikhona app. ACT Health (Government of Australia) custom solution to understand the local impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic. (CBR Health Study app, which is only visible in Australia) University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)'s research to collect health data from Apple Watch devices to operationalize digital phenotyping in the measurement of Anhedonia. (DGC App) University of Saskatchewan Medical School's research for caregivers to learn various skills that aid in self-compassion and self-care practices via our Eleos App. University of Rochester Medical Center's research to deliver home-based exercise interventions to older adults with blood cancer via our GO-EXCAP app. University of Saskatchewan Medical School's research to measure shoulder movements in breast cancer survivors via our Shoulder App. Vrije University’s NTR welbevinden research project to collect a combination of active and passive data from twins aiming to find new insights about the fluctuations of well-being and happiness.
